title: Late arriving data backfills the timeline without rewriting settled state
risk: Late telemetry rewrites a settled funnel state, so reporting and attribution change retroactively after a decision was already taken. Blueprint is silent on the resequencing window; the window used here is proposed configuration.
preconditions: Tenant T1 where checkout and purchase for cust-a were processed before the product_view arrived
Late evt_late_view_1 (occurred_at 09:58:30Z, ingested_at 10:04:00Z) delivered in namespace run-t1-late-*

steps.action: Ingest the late product_view and query the timeline and funnel projection
steps.expected: the timeline gains the view at its occurred_at position while the funnel stage stays purchase

steps.action: Re-run the decision stage for the same correlation id
steps.expected: no new decision is produced for the already-decided step, and the late signal does not re-open the run

steps.action: Deliver the same late event twice and once with a mutated occurred_at
steps.expected: the duplicate adds no entry and the mutated payload is rejected as a conflict instead of silently replacing history

steps.action: Read the attribution record for the purchase
steps.expected: attribution still points at the original decision and cites the settled evidence record

assertions: The settled funnel stage is still purchase and the decision timestamp is unchanged
Exactly one timeline entry exists for evt_late_view_1 at 09:58:30Z
The attribution record still references the original decision and evidence chain hash
forbidden: Re-open or re-decide a settled run because of late telemetry
Rewrite an existing timeline entry in place with a late payload
evidence: Timeline entries and funnel projection before/after the late delivery
Attribution record linkage (decision id, evidence chain hash) after the late delivery
cleanup: Delete the run-scoped late-event rows for run-t1-late-*; the append-only event log entry stays
automation: Inject the late event through the real normalizer with a frozen clock gap; the resequencing window is declared as proposed configuration because the blueprint does not fix it.
